Title: Create a task
Steps: A signed-in member can create a task with a title and due date.
Expected: The task appears on the board with the submitted values.

Title: Edit a task
Steps: The task owner updates the title and description.
Expected: The updated values are shown after saving.

Title: Assign a task
Steps: The task owner assigns an active member to a task.
Expected: The selected assignee appears in task details.

Title: Update task status
Steps: The assigned member changes the status of their task.
Expected: The new status appears on the board.

Title: Delete and restore a task
Steps: The owner moves a task to trash and an administrator restores it.
Expected: The restored task is visible on the board.

Title: Manage task comments
Steps: An authorized task participant adds and edits a comment.
Expected: The updated comment appears in task details.
